title: FDIC — Understanding Deposit Insurance
excerpt: FDIC deposit insurance covers $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, for each account ownership category. All deposits in the same ownership category at the same insured bank aggregate.

title: FDIC — Deposit Insurance FAQs
excerpt: Deposit insurance is calculated dollar-for-dollar, principal plus any interest accrued or due to the depositor, through the date of default.

title: FDIC — Your Insured Deposits At A Glance
excerpt: Single Accounts: $250,000 per owner. Joint Accounts: $250,000 per co-owner ($500,000 for two co-owners). Trust Accounts (effective April 1, 2024): $250,000 per eligible beneficiary up to $1,250,000 per owner (5 or more beneficiaries).
note: Statutory ownership categories establish legal multi-category expansion without relying on small local banks.
